research_summary: The strongest UK pages combine authoritative eligibility rules, current tariff tables and switching guidance. This page follows that answer-first pattern while adding benefit-specific caveats, a practical application sequence, credit-score reassurance and a balanced comparison with promotional mainstream deals.
depth_rationale: A minimum of 1,600 words is appropriate because the query spans eligibility, benefit verification, provider variation, tariff comparisons, switching, affordability support and six common follow-up questions. The depth is structured for retrieval rather than padded repetition.
